issues.description: Repeated 500 Internal Server Error responses on resource load. The page mounts twice (duplicate page:mount events logged) suggesting a double-render or StrictMode issue combined with a failing API/resource endpoint.
issues.element: Server-side resource / API call on auth page mount
issues.root_cause: The auth page likely makes an API call (e.g. checking session, fetching Google OAuth config, or loading an asset) on mount that returns 500. The duplicate page:mount events suggest either React StrictMode double-invocation or a useEffect running twice. The 400 error also suggests a malformed request being sent.

issues.description: page:mount event fires twice on every load (two consecutive identical log entries with nearly identical timestamps). This suggests a useEffect or analytics call is being triggered twice, possibly due to missing dependency guard or component being mounted in two places.
issues.element: page:mount analytics/tracking event in auth page
issues.root_cause: In apps/web/app/auth/page.tsx, the useEffect that logs page:mount likely has no cleanup or guard, and the component may be rendered twice (StrictMode or layout nesting).

issues.description: Console warning: 'Please ensure that the container has a non-static position, like relative, fixed, or absolute to ensure scroll offset is calculated correctly.' A container element is missing a non-static CSS position.
issues.element: A scrollable or positioned container in the auth page layout
issues.root_cause: A component (likely a dropdown, tooltip, or scroll-aware container) in the auth page or its children lacks position: relative/fixed/absolute styling.

fixes.reason: Prevents the page:mount event from firing on the cleanup/remount cycle in React StrictMode, eliminating the duplicate log entries.
Adds error handling to the Google config fetch that is likely causing the 500 error to go unhandled and crash silently, and prevents state updates on unmounted component.
